newsitem.title: UK: Halifax shares to be sold in daily tender.
newsitem.headline: Halifax shares to be sold in daily tender.

text.p: Britain's Halifax Plc said on Thursday orders had been received to sell a total of 7.58 million shares at the daily tender, representing about 0.3 percent of the newly-floated firm's share capital.
Halifax said bids would be accepted up to 1700 GMT on Thursday from pre-registered institutions and London Stock Exchange member firms.
Halifax's shares were up 1.5p at 734.5 by 1300 GMT.
The giant mortgage lender made its debut on Monday on the London stock market, ranking third among Britain's biggest listed banks.
